name: Duchess Deirdre
source:
Deirdre is the Duchess of Tior. Deirdre became Duchess upon the death of her oldest son, Daryl, who was married to the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]Prince[/url]'s sister, Sarah. Her youngest son was not of age. Deirdre hopes her grandson, Timon, will be the next Duke, rather than her youngest son. Deirdre is close to the [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King[/url] and often officiates on his behalf in the capital. Rumours abound that Deirdre was the King's true love and mistress for two or three decades.
